relations.subject: Ayya Khema
relations.place: Rancho La Puerta in Tecate, Mexico
relations.evidence: Khema moved with her infant son to Rancho La Puerta in Tecate, Mexico, to study the philosophy of the Essenes with Professor Edmund Skekely.

relations.subject: Ayya Khema
relations.evidence: A 1983 return trip to Sri Lanka, led her to meet her teacher, Ven. Matara Sri Ñānarāma of Nissarana Vanaya, who inspired her to teach jhana meditation.
